description:
v2 renames ``type`` -> ``entity_type`` and adds optional ``confidence``.

The rename makes v2 incompatible with v1, so we register a migration.

entity_type.description: Entity type code (e.g., PER, ORG, LOC).
entity_type.title: Entity Type

text.description: Surface form of the entity mention.
text.title: Text

confidence.description: Optional [0, 1] confidence — for soft labels and AI annotations.
confidence.title: Confidence
